name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – After § 1 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: 1c. Expresses deep concern over recent major corruption scandals in Ukraine, which raise doubts about the use of taxpayer money by the EU institutions and generate distrust among European citizens; insists on strict democratic oversight, transparent public accounting, international auditing, anti-corruption conditionality and the creation of an independent international oversight mechanism to prevent the diversion of resources and wartime profiteering;
